source.title: Huff, F.A. and Angel, J.R., 1992. Rainfall Frequency Atlas of the Midwest. Illinois State Water Survey Bulletin 71. Table 10, Median Time Distributions of Heavy Storm Rainfall at a Point, third-quartile column.

notes: Independent printing of the same median point distribution. The copy used is hosted by a third party (gcdcswm.com); its PDF metadata names Huff and Angel and the Midwestern Climate Center. Legacy curve: ISWS Bulletin 75 supersedes the Circular 173 / Bulletin 71 time distributions. Not printed in the Hydraflow manual, so Hydraflow equivalence is open.
